title: Enterprise triage framework for hosted API feature requests: chat, streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: We receive a steady stream of hosted API feature requests from enterprise customers asking for tighter controls and enhancements across four areas: multi-party chat semantics and role mapping, low-latency streaming with per-token authorization, robust tool/function-calling contract guarantees, and stricter structured-output (JSON schema + validation) for downstream systems. Goal: Create a repeatable triage framework and prioritized short-list (MVP features) that balances enterprise requirements (SLA, VPC/KMS, auditability), implementation effort, and business impact to inform roadmaps and sales conversations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented triage rubric that PM/Sales/Support can apply to incoming requests; 2) Top 8 feature requests mapped to implementation streams and engineering estimates; 3) Security/compliance flags for each request with clear gating; 4) Initial communication playbook for customers (commitments + timelines) and templated scoping questionnaire; 5) Hand-off artifacts to ENG/Design with owner and ETA.
scoring_matrix: We score requests on five axes: Customer scale (1-5), Revenue/ARR influence (1-5), Strategic fit (1-5), Implementation complexity (1-5, inverse), Compliance/Security risk (1-5). Weighting: Revenue 30%, Complexity 20%, Compliance 20%, Scale 20%, Strategic fit 10%. Example: A Fortune 100 asking for VPC-streaming + audit logs scores high on revenue and compliance and will be prioritized despite high complexity.
decision_log: 2025-02-12: Decided to prioritize features that reduce customer migration friction (VPC + function-calls contract) over UI enhancements. 2025-02-15: Agreed to include 'structured-output validation' as an MVP item because it reduces customer QA burden and lowers support load. 2025-02-18: Security flagged per-token authorization for streaming as high risk; requires SRE/SEC design review before implementation.
next_steps: 1) Share rubric and top-8 list with Solutions and Sales by 2025-02-21; 2) Kickoff ENG discovery (ENG-2104) focused on function-calling contracts and streaming auth by 2025-02-24; 3) Design to produce 2 interaction flows for enterprise chat role-mapping and consent by 2025-02-26; 4) Prepare customer scoping questionnaire template and include in Help Center; 5) Schedule security review meeting (SEC + SRE + ENG) for 2025-02-22.
